mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(hour_fee), 0) FROM seat_session WHERE status = 'FINISHED' AND end_time >= #{start} AND end_time < #{end}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(rent_fee), 0) FROM equipment_rental WHERE return_time >= #{start} AND return_time < #{end}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM recharge_record WHERE create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM seat_session WHERE status = 'FINISHED' AND end_time >= #{start} AND end_time < #{end}

WITH RECURSIVE date_seq AS ( SELECT CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AS dt UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(dt, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_seq WHERE dt < #{endDate} ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(dse.dt, '%m-%d') AS label, IFNULL(h.amount, 0) AS hourFee, IFNULL(p.amount, 0) AS productFee, IFNULL(r.amount, 0) AS rentFee FROM date_seq dse LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(end_time) AS d, SUM(hour_fee) AS amount FROM seat_session WHERE status = 'FINISHED' GROUP BY DATE(end_time) ) h ON h.d = dse.dt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(IFNULL(s.end_time, o.create_time)) AS d, SUM(o.amount) AS amount FROM product_order o LEFT JOIN seat_session s ON s.id = o.session_id WHERE o.session_id IS NULL OR s.status = 'FINISHED' GROUP BY DATE(IFNULL(s.end_time, o.create_time)) ) p ON p.d = dse.dt LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(return_time) AS d, SUM(rent_fee) AS amount FROM equipment_rental WHERE status = 'RETURNED' GROUP BY DATE(return_time) ) r ON r.d = dse.dt ORDER BY dse.dt

SELECT st.area AS name, IFNULL(SUM(s.hour_fee), 0) AS value FROM seat_session s JOIN seat st ON st.id = s.seat_id WHERE s.status = 'FINISHED' AND s.end_time >= #{start} AND s.end_time < #{end} GROUP BY st.area ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT p.name AS name, IFNULL(SUM(o.quantity), 0) AS qty, IFNULL(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS amount FROM product_order o JOIN product p ON p.id = o.product_id LEFT JOIN seat_session s ON s.id = o.session_id WHERE (o.session_id IS NULL OR s.status = 'FINISHED') AND IFNULL(s.end_time, o.create_time) >= #{start} AND IFNULL(s.end_time, o.create_time) < #{end} GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY qty DESC LIMIT #{limit}
